question: Which Indian female shooter won a silver medal in the women's skeet event at the ISSF Junior World Cup 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raiza Dhillon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Raiza Dhillon is an emerging talent in Indian shooting, particularly excelling in the skeet category.
 
• At the ISSF Junior World Cup 2025, she showcased her skills by securing a silver medal in the women's skeet event.
 
• The ISSF (International Shooting Sport Federation) Junior World Cup is a prestigious event for young shooters, providing a platform to demonstrate their abilities on the global stage.
 
• Raiza's achievement is significant as it highlights India's growing prominence in the field of shooting sports.
 
• She represents the next generation of Indian shooters who are making a mark in international competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maheshwari Chauhan**

 
 
• Maheshwari Chauhan is another prominent Indian shooter known for her performance in skeet shooting.
 
• She was the first Indian woman to win an individual skeet medal at the Asian Shooting Championship in 2017.
 
• Her achievements have inspired many young shooters in India to take up the sport.
 
 
 
• **Parinaaz Dhaliwal**
 
 
• Parinaaz Dhaliwal is an Indian shooter specializing in skeet events.
 
• Although she has represented India in various competitions, she has not yet achieved a podium finish at the ISSF Junior World Cup.
 
 
 
• **Ganemat Sekhon**
 
 
• Ganemat Sekhon is a notable Indian skeet shooter and the first Indian woman to win a medal in skeet at the ISSF World Cup.
 
• She won a bronze medal in the ISSF World Cup in 2021, marking a significant milestone for Indian shooting.
 
• Ganemat’s success has paved the way for other Indian female shooters in the skeet discipline.
